extDescription.message: Compact, offline TOTP codes: one row per account, click to copy.

fieldSecretKeep.message: Leave empty to keep the current key.

idleLock.message: Also lock when the computer is idle

idleLockNote.message: Uses Firefox's system idle detection and needs the optional “idle” permission. A locked screen alone is not detected; the auto-lock time above always applies.

idlePermissionDenied.message: Permission not granted; the idle lock stays off.

importTitle.message: Import (original extension totp.json or CTA unencrypted export)

importPreviewNote.message: Choose a file to see a preview. Nothing is saved until you confirm with your master password. Existing 2FA entries are never changed; duplicates are skipped; entries with the same name are kept.

importCounts.message: $NEW$ new, $DUP$ duplicates, $CONFLICT$ name conflicts, $NONAME$ without a name, $INVALID$ invalid

statusNameConflict.message: Name exists with a different key

errConflict.message: The data changed in the meantime; the list was reloaded. Please try again.

errMalformed.message: The file is not valid or not supported.

errUnknown.message: It is unknown whether the change was saved. The current list was reloaded; please check it before trying again.

savedLocked.message: The change was saved. The session was locked meanwhile; please unlock again.

reason_secret_format.message: secret key is not valid Base32

rowRaised.message: At this font size rows use $PX$ px so that no text is cut off.

rowEffectiveNote.message: Effective row height in the popup: $PX$ px.

unlockFailed.message: Unlock failed. Please check the password.

notInitialized.message: Not set up yet. Create a master password in the settings.

setupWarning.message: Your 2FA entries are encrypted with this password. There is no way to recover it: if you forget it, your 2FA entries are lost. Store it safely, e.g. in a password manager.

devNotice.message: Development build (0.x), not for production use. If you forget the master password, your 2FA entries can only be restored from an export you made before.

passwordRules.message: At least 12 characters. Long passphrases are welcome; no special character rules.

setupDone.message: Master password created. The vault is unlocked.

recoverableText.message: The current vault is damaged, but a verified backup of the same password generation is available. Restoring it may lose the most recent change.

vaultDamaged.message: The stored data is damaged and cannot be restored safely. Trying the password again does not help. Restore your 2FA entries from an encrypted export: remove CTA, install it again, set a master password and choose “Restore from an encrypted backup”.

vaultDamagedShort.message: The stored data is damaged. Open the settings to see how to restore your 2FA entries from an encrypted export.

restoreConfirm.message: I understand that the most recent change may be lost.

restoreDone.message: Backup restored. The vault is unlocked.

changePasswordNote.message: After the change the vault is locked; unlock it with the new password.

passwordChanged.message: Master password changed. Please unlock with the new password.

reason_password_short.message: the password needs at least 12 characters

reason_password_long.message: the password is too long (max. 1024 characters)

exportLegacy.message: Unencrypted totp.json for the original extension

exportEncryptedNote.message: The file is protected by its own export password. Without that password it cannot be opened, so store the password safely and separately from the file.

exportUseMaster.message: Use my master password as export password instead (not recommended)

exportPlainWarning.message: Warning: this file contains all secrets unencrypted. Anyone who gets it can generate your codes. Create it only when needed, keep it offline and delete it afterwards.

exportPlainConfirm.message: I understand that this file is not encrypted

legacyCompatible.message: All $COUNT$ 2FA entries can be written to totp.json without losing information.

legacyIncompatible.message: Not possible without losing information: the original extension supports only SHA-1, 6 digits and 30 seconds. Use the unencrypted CTA file instead. Affected 2FA entries:

exportDone.message: Encrypted export created ($COUNT$ 2FA entries) and handed to Firefox for saving. Check Firefox's downloads to confirm the file was saved; if you cancelled the save dialog, no file was saved.

exportPlainDone.message: Unencrypted file created ($COUNT$ 2FA entries) and handed to Firefox for saving. Check Firefox's downloads to confirm it was saved, and delete the file as soon as you no longer need it.

restoreExportNote.message: Restoring works only into an empty vault, that is right after setting a new master password. Existing 2FA entries are never overwritten or deleted. You need the export password of the file and the master password of this vault. If you already have entries, import an unencrypted CTA file instead; merging encrypted exports follows in a later version.

reason_export_password_same.message: the export password must differ from the master password (or choose the master-password option)

reason_legacy_incompatible.message: some 2FA entries cannot be represented in totp.json

reason_export_verify.message: the export could not be verified; no file was created

reason_vault_not_empty.message: restoring works only into an empty vault; your existing 2FA entries stay unchanged

reason_import_decrypt.message: wrong export password or damaged file

reason_text.message: the file is too large or unreadable

secretWeak.message: Short key (fewer than 16 characters): it works, but it is weaker than usual. Check that you copied the whole key.

savedWeak.message: Saved. Note: the key is shorter than 16 characters (weak but usable).

importNameLabel.message: Name for the entry without a name

importDone.message: $COUNT$ 2FA entries imported. Delete the unencrypted file now: it contains your secret keys in plain text.

importDoneSkipped.message: $IMPORTED$ 2FA entries imported, $SKIPPED$ skipped (reasons in the list below). Delete the unencrypted file now: it contains your secret keys in plain text.

reason_import_name.message: every entry without a name needs a name

reason_import_nothing.message: nothing to import (only duplicates or invalid entries)

importReread.message: The file could not be read again. Choose it again for a new preview.

contrastAdjustedDetail.message: The chosen text color $CHOSEN$ has too little contrast with the background ($RATIO$ : 1, at least $MIN$ : 1 is needed). To keep the text readable, the popup uses $USED$. Your choice stays saved; pick a lighter or darker color or another background.

lockedDuringAction.message: The session expired or was locked (automatic lock). The action was not carried out and nothing was changed. Unlock CTA and try again.

restoreWrongMaster.message: The master password of this vault is wrong. Nothing was restored.

restoreDecryptFailed.message: The backup could not be decrypted: the export password is wrong or the file is damaged. Nothing was restored.

restoreNotEmpty.message: Restoring works only into an empty vault. Your existing 2FA entries stay unchanged; nothing was restored.

sortNote.message: Sorting applies to the popup display. The table of 2FA entries here keeps your manual order.
